options.content: Chart view of execution: what was sent to the exchange, what was accepted, what was canceled, what was rejected, and what filled.

targets.rawSql:
WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    make_interval(secs => GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001))
  ) AS "time"
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT metric
  FROM (
    VALUES
      ('target orders'),
      ('placed orders'),
      ('canceled order ids'),
      ('rejected order commands'),
      ('fill events')
  ) AS m(metric)
),
data AS (
SELECT "time", metric, SUM(value) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
         'target orders'::text AS metric,
         SUM(
           jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(e.payload->'local'->'orders', '[]'::jsonb))
           + jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(e.payload->'global'->'orders', '[]'::jsonb))
         )::double precision AS value
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'strategy:target_books:' || id FROM unnest(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
  AND e.event_type = 'JointTargetBook'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(e.actor_id, ''), substring(e.topic from '^strategy:target_books:(.+)$')) = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
    AND e.event_type = 'JointTargetBook'
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
         'placed orders'::text AS metric,
         COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(e.payload->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)) AS o(value)
  WHERE e.event_type = 'PlaceOrdersAccepted'
    AND COALESCE(o.value->>'exchange', e.exchange, '') = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND COALESCE(o.value->>'symbol', e.symbol, '') = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
         'canceled order ids'::text AS metric,
         SUM(jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(e.payload->'order_ids', '[]'::jsonb)))::double precision AS value
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.event_type = 'CancelOrdersAccepted'
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND (e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR e.symbol IS NULL)
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
         'rejected order commands'::text AS metric,
         COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.event_type = 'OrderValidationRejected'
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND (e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR e.symbol IS NULL)
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
         'rejected order commands'::text AS metric,
         COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(e.payload->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)) AS o(value)
  WHERE e.event_type = 'PlaceOrdersFailed'
    AND COALESCE(o.value->>'exchange', e.exchange, '') = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND COALESCE(o.value->>'symbol', e.symbol, '') = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'timestamp_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'timestamp_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
         'fill events'::text AS metric,
         COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'private:state:' || id || ':fills' FROM unnest(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
) flow
GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT b."time", m.metric, COALESCE(d.value, 0.0) AS value
FROM buckets b
CROSS JOIN metrics m
LEFT JOIN data d
  ON d."time" = b."time"
 AND d.metric = m.metric
ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    make_interval(secs => GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001))
  ) AS "time"
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT metric
  FROM (
    VALUES
      ('sync requested'),
      ('completed'),
      ('failed'),
      ('target'),
      ('kept'),
      ('cancel'),
      ('place'),
      ('accepted'),
      ('rejected')
  ) AS m(metric)
),
data AS (
SELECT
  to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
  sync.metric,
  SUM(sync.value) AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  VALUES
    ('sync requested', CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'ExecutionSyncRequested' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END),
    ('completed', CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'ExecutionSyncCompleted' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END),
    ('failed', CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'ExecutionSyncFailed' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END),
    ('target', CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'ExecutionSyncCompleted' THEN CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'target_count', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'target_count', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END ELSE 0.0 END),
    ('kept', CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'ExecutionSyncCompleted' THEN CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'keep_count', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'keep_count', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END ELSE 0.0 END),
    ('cancel', CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'ExecutionSyncCompleted' THEN CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'cancel_count', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'cancel_count', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END ELSE 0.0 END),
    ('place', CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'ExecutionSyncCompleted' THEN CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'place_count', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'place_count', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END ELSE 0.0 END),
    ('accepted', CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'ExecutionSyncCompleted' THEN CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'accepted_count', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'accepted_count', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END ELSE 0.0 END),
    ('rejected', CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'ExecutionSyncCompleted' THEN CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'rejected_count', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'rejected_count', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END ELSE 0.0 END)
) AS sync(metric, value)
WHERE e.event_type IN ('ExecutionSyncRequested', 'ExecutionSyncCompleted', 'ExecutionSyncFailed')
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND (e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR e.symbol IS NULL)
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT b."time", m.metric, COALESCE(d.value, 0.0) AS value

WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    make_interval(secs => GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001))
  ) AS "time"
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT scope.exchange || ' ' || scope.symbol || ' ' || side.side AS metric
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.exchange, e.symbol
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.event_type IN ('StrategyDecision', 'ControllerDiagnostics', 'JointTargetBook')
    AND e.exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND e.symbol IS NOT NULL
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  ) AS scope
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('bid'), ('ask')) AS side(side)
),
data AS (
SELECT
  to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
  (COALESCE(o.value->>'exchange', e.exchange, 'unknown') || ' ' ||
   COALESCE(o.value->>'symbol', e.symbol, 'unknown') || ' ' ||
   CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END) AS metric,
  SUM(1.0) AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(e.payload->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)) AS o(value)
WHERE e.event_type = 'PlaceOrdersRequested'
  AND COALESCE(o.value->>'exchange', e.exchange, '') = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND COALESCE(o.value->>'symbol', e.symbol, '') = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
)

  SELECT generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    make_interval(secs => GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001))
  ) AS "time"
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT scope.exchange || ' ' || scope.symbol || ' validation unknown' AS metric
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.exchange, e.symbol
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.event_type IN ('StrategyDecision', 'ControllerDiagnostics', 'JointTargetBook')
    AND e.exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND e.symbol IS NOT NULL
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  ) AS scope
  UNION
  SELECT scope.exchange || ' ' || scope.symbol || ' place failed unknown' AS metric
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.exchange, e.symbol
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.event_type IN ('StrategyDecision', 'ControllerDiagnostics', 'JointTargetBook')
    AND e.exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND e.symbol IS NOT NULL
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  ) AS scope
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT
         COALESCE(e.exchange, 'unknown') || ' ' ||
         COALESCE(e.symbol, 'unknown') || ' validation ' ||
         COALESCE(NULLIF(e.payload->>'reason', ''), 'unknown') AS metric
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.event_type = 'OrderValidationRejected'
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND (e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR e.symbol IS NULL)
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT
         COALESCE(o.value->>'exchange', e.exchange, 'unknown') || ' ' ||
         COALESCE(o.value->>'symbol', e.symbol, 'unknown') || ' place failed ' ||
         COALESCE(NULLIF(e.payload->>'error', ''), 'unknown') AS metric
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(e.payload->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)) AS o(value)
  WHERE e.event_type = 'PlaceOrdersFailed'
    AND COALESCE(o.value->>'exchange', e.exchange, '') = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND COALESCE(o.value->>'symbol', e.symbol, '') = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
),
data AS (
SELECT "time", metric, SUM(value) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
         (COALESCE(e.exchange, 'unknown') || ' ' ||
          COALESCE(e.symbol, 'unknown') || ' validation ' ||
          COALESCE(NULLIF(e.payload->>'reason', ''), 'unknown')) AS metric,
         COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.event_type = 'OrderValidationRejected'
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND (e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR e.symbol IS NULL)
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
         (COALESCE(o.value->>'exchange', e.exchange, 'unknown') || ' ' ||
          COALESCE(o.value->>'symbol', e.symbol, 'unknown') || ' place failed ' ||
          COALESCE(NULLIF(e.payload->>'error', ''), 'unknown')) AS metric,
         COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(e.payload->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)) AS o(value)
  WHERE e.event_type = 'PlaceOrdersFailed'
    AND COALESCE(o.value->>'exchange', e.exchange, '') = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND COALESCE(o.value->>'symbol', e.symbol, '') = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
) rejected
GROUP BY 1, 2
)

    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    make_interval(secs => GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001))
  ) AS "time"
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT scope.exchange || ' ' || scope.symbol || ' ' || side.side AS metric
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.exchange, e.symbol
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.event_type IN ('StrategyDecision', 'ControllerDiagnostics', 'JointTargetBook')
    AND e.exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND e.symbol IS NOT NULL
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  ) AS scope
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('bid'), ('ask')) AS side(side)
),
data AS (
SELECT
  to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'timestamp_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'timestamp_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
  (COALESCE(e.exchange, e.payload->>'exchange', substring(e.topic from '^private:state:([^:]+):fills$'), 'unknown') || ' ' || COALESCE(COALESCE(e.symbol, e.payload->>'symbol'), 'unknown') || ' ' || CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END) AS metric,
  SUM(1.0) AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'private:state:' || id || ':fills' FROM unnest(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
)

metrics AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         COALESCE(gate.value->>'role', 'unknown') || ' ' || gate.key || ' ' || status.metric AS metric
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
    COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)
  ) AS gate(key, value)
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES ('has orders'), ('can sync'), ('live')
  ) AS status(metric)
  WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'strategy:diagnostics:' || id FROM unnest(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
),
data AS (
SELECT
  to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
  (COALESCE(gate.value->>'role', 'unknown') || ' ' || gate.key || ' ' || status.metric) AS metric,
  MAX(CASE WHEN status.ok THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
  COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)
) AS gate(key, value)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  VALUES
    ('has orders', lower(trim(COALESCE(gate.value->>'has_orders', 'false'))) IN ('true', 't', '1', 'yes')),
    ('can sync', lower(trim(COALESCE(gate.value->>'can_sync', 'false'))) IN ('true', 't', '1', 'yes')),
    ('live', lower(trim(COALESCE(gate.value->>'live', 'false'))) IN ('true', 't', '1', 'yes'))
) AS status(metric, ok)
WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'strategy:diagnostics:' || id FROM unnest(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
)

SELECT exchange
FROM (
  SELECT exchange, max(latest_ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
  SELECT exchange, updated_at AS latest_ts
  FROM registry_exchanges
  WHERE status = 'active'
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
  ) sources
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND CAST(exchange AS text) <> ''
  GROUP BY exchange
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC
